title: Smiling Father with Two Young Children, 1958 Home B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black-and-white family portrait stamped 'APR 58' on the top border. A smiling father in a collared shirt sits on a bed or sofa holding his two young children: an ecstatic baby laughing openly and a fair-haired toddler gazing curious towards the camera. A stuffed rabbit toy sits nestled by patterned wallpaper in the background, capturing an intimate moment of mid-century American domestic life.
